name: Ascend
effect:
Creates a gust of wind to lift you up. 
Move up to 5 tiles up and up to 2 tile in any other direction. 
Creatures have disadvantage on reactive strike reacting to this.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the distance 2 tiles up and 1 tile in another direction

name: Blinding Flash
effect:
Send a blinding flash of light at a creature. It must make a Fortitude save 
 Success: Target is dazzled for one turn.
 Failure: Target is blinded for one turn and dazzled for one minute 
 Critical Failure: Target is blinded for one minute
While affected by this spell, the target can spend one action to attempt to redo the save, removing the remaining effects on a success.

name: Chill
effect:
Freeze an medium or smaller object or creature, dealing 3d4 cold damage with a basic Fortitude save.
On a critical failure the target is partially frozen and has move speed reduced by 2 tiles next turn. 
If the target is standing in water it has a -3 penalty to the save 
If you spend two actions on the spell the range increases to 3 tiles.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 2d4

name: Control Water
effect:
Allows the caster to shape and manipulate water, creating simple shapes or moving water around. 
While the spell doesn't offer permanent control, it can be used to redirect small rivers, create temporary barriers, or even form small tools made of water. 
The water returns to its natural state after the spell ends.

name: Darken
effect:
Creates a zone of darkness of up to 9 joining tiles that blocks out non-magical lights. 
If you spend 3 actions on this spell, the zone can be up to 15 tiles

name: Earthglide
effect:
Glide along the earth, creating rough terrain in your wake. 
Move up to 6 tiles in a line across the ground, and cause any tile you move across to become rough terrain. 
If your next action is to cast a Earth spell, it costs 1 action less.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the distance by 3 tiles

name: Ferrokinesis
target: One unenchanted metal object of light weight or less
effect:
Move a piece of metal of light weight or less up to spells range, if you move it into your space you may catch it with a free hand. 
If you attempt to move a metal object that's being held, the holder gets a to attempt a Fortitude save against the spell. 
Enchanted metal or artifice typically has runes to prevent it being moved with spells. 
You can use this spell to shoot a metal object at an enemy in range, dealing 2d8 physical damage with a basic Reflex save.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d8

name: Firebolt
effect:
Throw a bolt of fire against a target, dealing 2d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save. 
On a critical failure the target is also set on fire, taking 1d6 persistent fire damage.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d6

name: Flameshape
effect:
Can be used to light candles, create patterns, or manipulate flames for visual effects. 
Cannot be used to deal damage directly. 
Can be cast as a Complex spell to also change the color of fire.
upcast: By Rank: You can control an additional fire

name: Gentle Breeze
effect:
Summons a cool breeze that refreshes and soothes,  common spell in hot climates or social gatherings. 
The first time each day a creature is affected by this spell it loses one level of exhaustion. 
If you spend 3 actions on this spell, the area increases to a 3 tiles burst from the caster

name: Glide
effect:
Allows the caster to glide down with the wind. 
Gives the caster a Glide speed equal to their land speed for the turn. 
After casting the spell the caster can glide as a free action.

name: Glow
target: One object or creature of size small or smaller
effect:
Cause an object or creature to glow spreading light for 4 tiles, and dim light for 4 more. 
The light can be dismissed with an action. 
If the target is a creature or held object, the creature gets a Reflex save to resist the spell

name: Gravel Spray
effect:
Throw a barrage of gravel or other small bits of earth in a cone. 
Creatures inside the cone need to make a basic Fortitude saving throw or take 2d4 physical damage. 
The area affected by the spell becomes difficult terrain. 
 If you spend three actions on this spell it deals 3d4 damage and the area is a 5 tile cone.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d4

name: Featherfall
actions: Reaction, when you see a creature or group of creatures falling
target: A group of creatures up to your INT/WIL
effect:
Guide a group creatures down on a blanket of wind.
The creatures gently fall down at a speed of 10 tiles each round, taking no fall damage and landing standing.
You cannot use this spell on creatures larger than medium
upcast:
At Adept: You can use this on Large Creatures
At Grand Magus: You can use this on Huge Creatures

name: Gust
effect:
Creates a sudden burst of wind that can push away small objects, unbalance foes, or snuff out small flames. If the target is a creature it must make a Reflex or Fortitude save. 
 Success: Target is knocked back 1 tile or knocked off-guard 1 (targets choice)
 Failure: Target is knocked back 2 tiles and knocked off-guard 2
 Critical Failure: Target is knocked back 4 tiles and knocked prone
A light object is pushed 4 tiles back. This spell cannot push large or larger creatures. You may increase the actions spent on the spell to increase the amount of tiles of knockback by 2 for each action.

name: Heat
effect:
Heat an medium or smaller object or creature, dealing 2d4 fire damage with a basic Fortitude save. 
The effect can be lessened to warm food or objects to a pleasant temperature. I
f the target is a created affected by an Ice spell, your may attempt to remove it, giving it a new save against the effect.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 2d4

name: Icy Floor
effect:
Freeze the ground in a 4x4 tiles large area. 
Any creatures that walks across one of those squares must make a DC 13 Acrobatics check or fall prone. 
If another effect would cause the creature to fall prone while standing on Icy Floor, it has a -5 penalty to that check.

name: Ignite
effect:
Lights a flammable object or creature on fire. 
If the target is a creature it can make a Reflex or Fortitude save. 
On a failure it's set on fire, taking 1d8 persistent fire damage. 
It can use on action its turn to repeat the save, ending the spell on success

name: Interpose Earth
actions: Reaction, when you would have to make a Reflex save
effect:
Using your magic you throw a nearby piece of earth to block part of the attack. Make the save with +3 modifier. 
You may cast this when allies within 3 tiles would have to make a save instead, giving them the bonus. If you do the spell has the complex trait.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the modifier by 1

name: Magnetic Field
effect:
Surround yourself with a field that rebounds metal.
You have a +4 bonus to Reflex saves against metal weapons or projectiles.

name: Magnetic Rebound
actions: Reaction, when you would have to make a Reflex save against an attack by a metal weapon or projectile.
effect:
Attempt to move the metal out of the way. 
Use the Spellshaping check instead of making a Reflex Saving Throw
On a critical success you may select another valid target for the attack instead

name: Magnetize
effect:
Magnetize a target to make it easier for metal objects to hit it.
Target creature makes a Wil save.
On a success they are magnetized for one round
On a failure they are magnetized for a minute
On a critical they are magnetized for a minute and the effect is doubled.
While magnetized they have a -2 penalty to Reflex saves against Metal weapons and projectiles

name: Illusory Object
effect:
Weave an illusion of an stationary object or creature in range 
The object is medium or smaller and anything can pass through it.
upcast:
At Adept: You can use this create Large Illusions
At Magus: You can use this create Huge Illusions
At Archmage : You can use this create Gargantuan Illusions

name: Metal Shards
effect:
Shoot three small shards of metal at targets of your choosing. 
They deal 1d4 damage each with a basic Reflex save. 
If you spend three actions you shoot one extra needle.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the amount of needles by 1

name: Mold Earth
effect:
Use your magic to shape small bits of earth. 
You an make an 2 tile high, 1 tile large earthen pillar that provides greater cover or turn 4 adjacent tiles rough, creating difficult terrain. 
With more time you can make simple shapes and constructions out of earth, though they fall apart after an hour.

name: Momentary Acceleration
effect:
A flash of time magic accelerates a group of creatures.
Choose a number of creatures in range up to your INT.
They become Hastened 1 for one turn

name: Move with the Wind
effect:
Connect to the wind, becoming faster and more agile. 
Your movement speed increases by 2 tiles and you gain a +2 bonus to Reflex saving throws. 
When you cast or sustain this spell you may stride (or fly if you have a flying speed), ignoring difficult terrain for that action.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the modifiers by 1

name: Muddy Ground
effect:
Create an 5x5 tiles large area of mud, slowing down those that walk over it. 
The area is difficult terrain for up to an hour.

name: Null
effect:
Use rare void magic to attempt to tear through magical defenses, dealing no physical damage, but destroying auras
The target must make a basic WIL save, on a failure it takes 3d4 aura damage
This damage only targets auras and magical defenses, dealing full damage to auras.
If the target has no aura or magical defenses, this spell has no effect
Every extra action you spend on the spell increases its damage by 2d4
Void magic is dangerous, on a failed spellshape you take half the aura damage instead.

name: Quick Jet
effect:
With a quick jet of flame you propel yourself forward horizontally in a line.
Travel up to 6 tiles forward in a line, treating difficult terrain one step less.
This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks
You can use this spell to cross gaps, though if you end your movement in midair after casting it you fall
You may choose to travel 4 tiles diagonally up or down instead
upcast: By Rank: Increase the movement distance by 2

name: Rock Toss
effect:
Use your magic to throw a bit of loose earth or a rock against a target, dealing 1d6 physical damage with a basic Reflex save. 
If you spend two actions on this spell it throws a larger rock, dealing 1d10 damage. 
If you spend three actions on this spell it throws an even larger rock, dealing 1d12 damage and knocking the target prone on a critical failure
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage dice amount by 1

name: Slip
actions: Reaction, when you see another creature in range take the Stride action
effect:
You manipulate water or ice to make a moving creature slip.
It must make a Reflex saving throw.
 Success: The creature must stop its movement or become off-guard 1 until the end of your next turn
 Failure: The creature falls prone
 Critical Failure: The creature falls prone and takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage.

name: Soul Ward
effect:
The basics of soul magic is protecting your own.
You project an invisible field that gives you a +5 bonus on WIL saves against spells, attacks and effects with the soul traits while the spell is active.
You also have a +1 bonus on other WIl saves
upcast: At Grand Magus: The spell does not need to be sustained

name: Sturdy as Stone
effect:
Infuse yourself with the earth. 
Gain resistance 5 to physical damage, and a +3 bonus to fortitude saving throws, but a -1 tile speed penalty. 
If you would become prone or off-guard you may dismiss this spell to avoid becoming prone or off-guard. 
The benefits of this spell stop working while you are in the air.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the modifiers by 1

name: Water Bullet
effect:
Creates a compressed bullet of water to strike at a creature, dealing 2d12 piercing damage with a basic Reflex save. 
If you stand in or next to water the spell only costs 2 actions to cast
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d10

name: Water Push
effect:
Creates a blast of water to push a creature. It must make a Reflex or Fortitude save. 
 Success: Target is pushed 1 tile back 
 Failure: Target is pushed 3 tiles back 
 Critical Failure: Target is pushed 3 tiles back and knocked off-guard 2
 For each size above Medium the creature is pushed 2 tiles less. 
If you are standing in water the range or spend three actions on the spell, it instead targets all creatures in a 5 tile line from you. This gives the spell the Draining Trait

name: Zap
effect:
Sends a weak but very fast bolt of electricity at the target, dealing 1d8 lightning damage. 
If the target is wearing armor made of metal or holding a metal object it makes a Reflex save with a -4 modifier, otherwise the modifier is -2.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d8

name: Accelerate Self
effect:
With a quick cast you move in a burst of speed
Gain Hastened 3 this turn
You can´t be affected by Accelerate Self for 1d4 turns
upcast: At Grand Magus: Gain Hastened 4 instead

name: Air Bubble
effect:
Creates a bubble of air which allows the user to breathe in environments without breathable air like underwater or toxic areas. 
When casting the spell you can choose to extend the area to the adjacent tiles, if you do the spell takes 3 actions and gives the spell the Draining Trait.

name: Barricade
effect:
Forms a barricade of metal or stone on 5 connected tiles. 
The barricade provides cover. You can choose if it blocks line of sight or not. 
If you spend 3 actions on the spell the barricade is 8 tiles long.

name: Beam of Light
effect:
Casts a beam of light that can blind a multiple creatures in a 1 tile wide, 6 tiles long line. Any creatures in the line must make a Fortitude save. 
Success: Target is dazzled for one turn. 
Failure: Target is blinded for one turn and dazzled for one minute. 
Critical Failure: Target is blinded for one minute. 
While affected by this spell, the target can spend one action to attempt to redo the save, removing the remaining effects on a success.

name: Water Breathing
effect:
Connect to the waters and absorb the air you need from it.
While the spell is active you can breathe water as if were air and use verbal underwater
Additionally you have advantage on saves against deep sea preassure and similar threats
upcast:
At Magus: Increase the duration to 10 Minutes
At Grand Magus: Increase the duration to 1 Hour
At Archmage: Increase the duration to 8 Hours

name: Breathe Fire
effect:
Create a cone of fire to burn your enemies. 
Creatures inside the cone need to make a basic Reflex save. 
On a failure they take 3d6 fire damage. 
The cone is 4 or 6 tiles large, depending on the amount of actions used to cast the spell
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d6

name: Conjure
effect:
The simplest teleportation magic, Conjure brings a runed item to the caster.
Teleports a medium or smaller item within range with a Conjuration rune that you have drawn to you. 
If you have a free hand you can catch it in your hand.
upcast:
By Rank: Double the range per rank
At Grand Magus: You can conjure Large items

name: Illusory Wall
effect:
Conjure an illusory wall, taking any shape you want.
The wall is up to six tiles long and can appear solid or passable.
You may also use the wall to hide creatures behind it
Creatures, objects and projectiles can pass through the wall, and any creatures that see something pass through the wall can find it.

name: Detect Metal
effect:
Allows the caster to detect metal through objects.
Gives you a precise metalsense with a range of 5, which works through non-magical materials

name: Dispell
effect:
Attempt to counteract a spell or magical effect on a target you can touch.
Use your Spellshaping check versus the Spellshaping check of the caster of the spell.
On a success you end the effect on the targeted creature
The targets check has a +3 bonus for each rank of their spell higher than the rank you cast this spell at

name: Earth Tremor
effect:
Causes the earth to shake in a area around you.
Creatures other than you in a 5 tile burst need to make a Reflex or Fortitude save or take 1d8 bludgeoning damage and fall prone

name: Heat Metal
effect:
Heat a set of metal armor or weapon.
The wearer or holder needs to can make Reflex spell to avoid it
On a failure the item is heated, dealing 2d4 fire damage at the start of the holders turn.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d4

name: Earthen Armor
effect:
Forms armor of hardened earth or stone around the caster
It counts as heavy armor, but you are proficiencient with this armor even if they don't have armor proficiency.
The armor has resistance 8 to physical damage and resistance 4 to elemental damage. 
It has a Weak Point Difficulty of 10 and provides a +3 bonus to Fortitude saves and athletics checks.
While wearing the armor you have a -2 tile move speed.
The armor imposes a -3 armor penalty
upcast: By Rank: Increase the physical resistance by 2 and elemental resistance by 1

name: Earthen Launch
effect:
Boost yourself away with a sudden burst of earth magic.
To cast this spell you need to be on solid ground connected to the earth. 
Jump up to five tiles up and seven tiles in any direction. 
If you land on a creature they need to make Reflex saving throw or take 2d6 bludgeoning damage

name: Electrify
effect:
The caster electrifies a melee weapon, causing it to deal an additional 1d12 of lightning damage on a hit.
If the weapon falls into water or the wielder fails a saving throw from a Water trait the effect ends, and lightning zaps all creatures in a 2 tile burst dealing 2d10 damage with a basic Fortitude save
upcast: At Grand Magus: Increase the damage by 1d12

name: Flame Jet
effect:
The caster unleashes a jet of flame in a 8 tiles long straight line, dealing 2d8 fire damage to all creatures in its path. 
Creatures in the line must make a basic Reflex save. 
The caster can choose to be pushed up to 3 tiles away from direction of the flame, moving without provoking opportunity attacks.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d8

name: Heatwave
effect:
You create a wide 8x8 area of scorching air.
Any creatures inside need to make a basic Fortitude save or take 2d4 fire damage.
On a critical failure creatures also take one level of exhaustion
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 2d4

name: Hone Edge
effect:
You sharpen a blade to a fine point.
Choose a metal weapon or up to five pieces of ammunition that deal slashing or piercing damage.
They deal an additional 1d8 damage for the duration
upcast: At Grand Magus: Increase the damage by 1d8

name: Ice Shard
effect:
Throw a shard of ice against a target, dealing 3d6 piercing damage with a basic Reflex save. 
On a critical failure the damage dice of this spell increases to d10's
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d6

name: Inflame
effect:
Conjure flames hands, harmless to you, but dangerous to others
Any creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 1d6 fire damage. 
Your unarmed melee attacks deal an extra d6 fire damage
When cast or sustained you can make an unarmed melee strike as part of the same action
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d4

name: Levitate
effect:
You defy gravity and levitate the target 1 tile off the ground. When you sustain you can move the target up or down 10 feet. 
A creature floating in the air from levitate takes a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls, but can spend an Interact action to stabilize itself and negate this penalty for the remainder of its turn.
If the target is adjacent to a fixed object or terrain of suitable stability, it can move across the surface by climbing (if the surface is vertical, like a wall) or crawling (if the surface is horizontal, such as a ceiling). 
Creatures with a Glide speed have a Flight speed when affected by this spell.

name: Lightning Shroud
effect:
The caster is surrounded by crackling electricity, dealing 2d6 lightning damage to any creature that hits them with a melee attack or grapples them. 
The caster also gains resistance 5 to lightning damage.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d6 and resistance by 3

name: Orbiting Earth
effect:
You shape three rocks or pieces of debris into projectiles that orbit you.
While they orbit you can use a reaction to interpose them in the way of incoming attacks, making a Spellshaping check instead of a Fortitude or Reflex save.
When you sustain this spell you may make an attack with one of the earths, dealing 1d10 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex save.
When you block or attack with this spell you lose one orbiter, if you run out of orbiters the spell ends.
If you spend 3 actions on this spell you raise four orbiters
upcast: By Rank: Increase the amount of orbiters by 1

name: Propel
actions: Reaction, when you see an ally stride within reach
effect:
You help your ally along with a push of wind.
Increase the move distance by 2 or 4 if the ally is moving directly away from you.
You can also use this spell to give an ally +5 on Jump Check
upcast: By Rank: Increase the tiles moved by 2.

name: Purify Water
effect:
Removes pollutants, toxins, and harmful substances from a body of water, making it safe to drink. 
The purified water remains clean for up to 1 hour.
The first time each day creatures drink purified water they lose one level of exhaustion

name: Quick Forge
effect:
The caster can quickly repair or forge a simple metal object, such as a weapon, tool, or piece of armor. 
The object must be small enough to hold in one hand. 
The repaired or forged item is functional but not masterfully crafted. 
The magic keeping the object together fades after the spell ends and it deforms or returns to its earlier state.

name: Sense Water
effect:
A utility spell that allows the caster to sense nearby sources of water within 20 tiles, even if they are hidden underground or behind obstacles. 
The caster can determine the direction and approximate distance to the nearest water source.

name: Shape Bone
effect:
The caster can reshape a small bone or bone fragment into a simple tool, weapon, or decorative item. 
The reshaped bone retains its original durability but can be customized for specific purposes, such as a bone dagger or needle. 
The object must be no larger than what can be held in one hand.

name: Soul Sight
effect:
With an incantation you can see the souls of others.
While this spell is active you have the effect of Soul Sight advantage.
upcast: At Archmage: The spell does not need to be sustained

name: Stalagmite
effect:
The caster causes a stalagmite to rise from the ground in an unoccupied space within range. 
The stalagmite is 2 tiles tall and provides cover. 
If cast under a creature, the creature must make a Reflex save or be speared by the stalagmite, taking 3d6 piercing damage and becoming pinned until they make a Athletics check against the Spellshaping roll.

name: Steam Cloud
effect:
Creates a 4-tile-large cloud of steam that obscures vision. 
Creatures within the cloud have a -5 penalty to visual perception checks. 
The cloud dissipates if exposed to strong wind. 
If the previous action was to cast a Water or Fire spell, this spell only costs 1 Action

name: Tailwind
effect:
The caster creates a gust of wind that propels a target creature forward, increasing their movement speed by 2 tiles for the duration. 
The target can choose to move in any direction but must move at least 1 tile per turn.

name: Teleport
effect: Teleport to a tile you can see within range.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the range by 10

name: Tremor Sense
effect:
The caster gains the ability to sense vibrations through the ground, allowing them to detect movement within range. 
This can reveal hidden or invisible creatures, but won't detect flying or hovering creatures. 
The caster has a 12 range Tremor Sense as a precise sense
upcast: At Grand Magus: The spell does not need to be sustained

name: Water Arm
effect:
Create a tentacle of water that can grab things or attack. 
While the spell is active, you have the Water Tentacle and Water Slam strikes. 
You can also use an action to grab a small object within 30 feet with an arm. Each conjured water arm also gives you a climb speed of 2 tiles while you don't have a grabbed creature. 
Water Tentacle has range 4, hands 1 and deals 2d6 bludgeoning damage. On a hit you can also grab a creature.
Water Slam has range 5, hands 1, the shove trait and deals 2d8 bludgeoning damage.
upcast: By Rank: Increase amount of water arms by 1

name: Water Ball
effect:
Create a hovering ball of water, 4x4 tiles wide. 
When you cast or sustain the spell you can move the ball up to 3 tiles.
Any creatures that move into the ball or that the ball moves into need to make Reflex or Fortitude saving throws or become trapped in the ball.
Creatures trapped in the ball are move along with it. 
They can make Athletics checks to try to get out of. 
Creatures with a swimming speed can swim out of the ball without needing to make a check

name: Water Walk
effect:
Grants the creature the ability to walk on the surface of water or other liquids as if they were solid ground. 
The caster can move at their normal speed and does not need to make any checks to balance.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the amount of targets by 1

name: Wave Dash
effect:
Create a slamming wave, a 4 tile cone of water from your position, dealing 2d6 bludgeoning damage
Creatures hit by the spell need to make a basic Fortitude save
Creatures who fail the spell are also pushed along 2 tiles with it, or 4 tiles on a critical failure
You may choose to ride the wave, arriving anywhere on the edge of the cone.
If you cast this spell in water the cone is 6 tiles long and the spell does 2d8 damage

name: Whirlwind
effect:
Creates a whirlwind in a 3x3 tile area. 
Creatures within the whirlwind must make a Fortitude save at the start of their turn: 
 Failure: The creature is lifted 2 tiles into the air and takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage. 
 Critical Failure: The creature is lifted 4 tiles into the air and takes 4d6 bludgeoning damage. 
When you sustain this you can move the whirlwind up to 3 tiles, carrying creatures inside the whirlwind with it.
The first time each turn you move the whirlwind into a creatures space, they must make a Fortitude save
upcast: By Rank: Increase the amount of tiles creatures are lifted by 1 and the damage by 1d6

name: Wind Wall
effect:
Creates a wall of strong wind, 10 tiles long and 3 tiles high. 
The wall blocks gaseous forms, such as clouds, and imposes a -4 penalty to ranged attack rolls passing through it. 
Small or smaller creatures attempting to move through the wall must make a Fortitude save or be pushed back 2 tiles.

name: Air Slice
effect:
Send out a swift slice of cutting wind.
It deals 2d10 slashing damage with a basic Reflex save.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d10

name: Blink
effect:
With a flash of magic you appear elsewhere
Teleport to a tile you can see within range.
upcast: By Rank: Increase range by 6

name: Creeping Shadows
effect:
Create a spreading cloud of darkness that seems to cling onto whatever they touch. 
Creates a zone of darkness of up to 9 joining tiles that blocks out non-magical lights.  
Any creatures in the darkness at the start of their turn need to make a Will save or be Frightened 1. 
When you sustain this you can extend the darkness by 3 tiles.

name: Dust Devil
effect:
Create a (2 tile burst) whirling swirl of air and dust in range. 
When you create it and move it, creatures inside it need to make a Fortitude saving throw
On a failed save they take 1d8 slashing damage and have -3 penalty to perception checks and ranged attacks until they take an action to clear dust from their eyes.
When you sustain this you can move the dust devil 3 tiles.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the burst size by 1 tile

name: Fire Whip
effect:
Creates a Fire Whip weapon in hand. 
It deals 2d6 fire damage, has a +2 item bonus to attack, range 4 and is held in one hand.
It has the agile, finesse and deadly (d8) traits.
It's in the flail weapon group.
When you sustain this spell you can make make a Strike with the weapon.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d4

name: Fireball
effect:
Creates a 5 tiles burst of fire at a location you can see within range.
It deals 5d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save

name: Fly
effect:
Connects you to the wind, allowing you to fly freely.
You gain a 4 tiles flight speed. 
When you sustain this spell you may fly as a free action
upcast: By Rank: Increase the flying speed by 2

name: Lava Wave
effect:
The caster summons a deadly but slow moving wave of lava.
The wave is up to three tiles wide and one tile thick. 
When cast and sustained the wave travels 5 tiles forward. 
Creatures hit by the wave need to make a Reflex saving throw or take 4d8 fire damage.

name: Giant Stone Hand
effect:
Conure a giant stone hand that you can control.
The stone hand is created at a space you can see within range
The stone hand is a large creature with health equal to your Spellshaping roll and resistance 6 to physical and elemental damage.
When you cast or sustain this spell, and as a basic action you may move the hand 3 spaces, restore 1d6 + your INT or WIL health to it, make a Grab attack, or position the hand provide greater cover to adjacent allies.
Grab attacks are made with using your Spellshaping roll, and do 2d6 damage and with the Improved Grab trait.

name: Hail of Nails
effect:
Creates a rain of small metallic projectiles in a 8x8 area. 
It deals 3d8 physical damage with a basic Reflex save
The first time you sustain this spell each turn, you may spend an action to repeat the hail targeting the same or a new area

name: Haste
effect:
By subtly manipulating the timestream around you can move slightly faster than normal
You are quickened 1.
If you spend 3 actions on this spell you can target an adjacent willing creature instead

name: Lightning Bolt
effect:
Create a bolt of lightning to strike a target in range
The target needs to make a basic Reflex save, taking 4d12 lightning damage on failure.
If the target is wearing armor made of metal or holding a metal object it makes this save with a -4 modifier, otherwise the modifier is -2.

name: Shunt
effect:
Reach out to a creature and teleport them.
If the creature is hostile it can make a WIL save to resist.
On a failure you may teleport them to a destination within 6 tiles

name: Slow
effect:
By subtly manipulating the timestream around you can slow it's movement and perception of the world.
It must make a Will save.
Success: Target is slowed 1 for one round
Failure: Target is slowed 1 for the spells duration
Critical Failure: Target is slowed 2 for the spells duration
The target may attempt to redo the save at end of turn
upcast: By Rank: Choose one more creature

name: Thunder Rush
effect:
Taking on some of the speed of lightning lets you move faster and zap any targets as you move by them.
When you cast and sustain the spell you can take the Stride action
Your movespeed increases by 2
Creatures have disadvantage on opportunity attacks against you
Once per turn, when you move adjacent to a creature they take d4 lightning damage.

name: Thunder Step
effect:
Teleport to a tile you can see within range.
Creatures within 5 tiles of where you teleported and/or where you teleported from take 3d8 thunder damage with a basic Fortitude save

name: Water Jet
effect:
Create a high pressure jet of water in a 1 tile wide, 12 tiles long line
It deals 4d8 piercing damage with a basic Reflex save

name: Chain Lightning
effect:
Create a bolt of lightning to strike a target in range, that then arcs to strike other nearby creatures
The target needs to make a basic Reflex save, taking 3d12 lightning damage on failure.
If the target is wearing armor made of metal or holding a metal object it makes this save with a -4 modifier, otherwise the modifier is -2.
Whether on a hit or not, you may then direct the spell to another target within 4 tiles. 
You may keep the chain going for up to 5 bounces as it hits new targets.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d12

name: Cold Snap
effect:
Create an impact of extreme cold at a point in range.
Creatures in a 4x4 area around the point need to make a Fortitude saving throw.
 Success: The creature takes half damage.
 Failure: The creature takes 5d8 cold damage and is frozen 1
 Critical Failure: The creature takes double damage and is frozen 2
Creatures in a 8x8 area around the point take half as much damage and aren't frozen
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 2d8

name: Disintegrate
effect:
Send a beam of pure unraveling magic at a creature or object in range.
It deals 5d12 force damage with a basic Reflex Saving throw.
Shields, armors and objects hit by Disintegrate are destroyed unless they are enchanted with anti-magic runes or made of Adamantium or Mithril
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 2d12

name: Fiery Body
effect:
Turn your body into fire. 
While sustaining this spell you cannot be grappled, restrained or have your movespeed reduced.
Any creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 3d6 fire damage. 
Your unarmed melee attacks deal an extra 2d6 damage and is all fire damage.
You are immune to fire damage and effects from fire spells.
You can use a reaction to reform around a damaging attack or effect, increasing the result of a Reflex saving throw one step
You have vulnerability 10 to cold damage and damage from water spells. 
When in water or restrained by water spells you take 2d6 vital damage at the start of your turn.

name: Steelskin
effect:
Covers the caster’s body with a layer of metallic armor that doesn't hinder movement, offering extraordinary protection against physical attacks. 
Grants resistance 15 to physical damage, resistance 10 to fire, cold and acid damage, and a +5 bonus to fortitude saving throws. 
The steel attracts lightning however, giving you a minus -4 penalty to saves against lightning effects

name: Storm
effect:
Conjure a storm of pouring rain and wind in a 100 tile area.
All creatures under the storm clouds become wet and take half damage from fire but double from ice and lightning.
The storm obscures vision, giving a -3 penalty to all visual perception checks
If the spell is sustained for a minute, loose dirt and ground turn to mud that counts as difficult terrain
upcast: At Archmage: The spell takes only 3 actions

name: Wall of Fire
effect:
Conjure a wall of flames to hurt any that dare walk through
The wall is 10 tiles long of adjoining tiles.
Creatures that start their turn in the wall or that walk into it take 4d6 fire damage.

name: Waterspout
effect:
Creates a 3 tiles burst, 10 tiles high waterspout within range. Creatures at that location need to make a Reflex or Fortitude saving throw. 
 Success: The creature takes half damage and is pushed up 3 tiles
 Failure: The creature takes 3d10 bludgeoning damage and is pushed up 8 tiles
 Critical Failure: The creature takes double damage and is pushed up 12 tiles
Creatures pushed up by the spell fall down afterwards, taking fall damage as normal.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d10

name: Wind Walk
effect:
You select up an amount of creatures equal to 4 + your INT (or WIL if cast as an Attuned Spell). 
You may include yourself.
The chosen creatures gain a flight speed equal to their walking speed for the duration.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the flying speed by 2

name: Dimensional Net
actions: Reaction, when you see a projectile within range
effect:
Conjure a dimensional net to catch an incoming projectile without the Dimensionalism trait. 
If your spellshaping roll is higher than the projectile, you catch it in the net and it's stopped before it can hit its intended target
Projectiles caught in the net are stored there while the spell is sustained and can be unleashed as a two action activity.
Open Net - Target a point within 5 tiles and set a direction.
Projectiles from the net fly forward in your chosen direction. If the projectile had a set target, you may select a new one.
If you fail to sustain the spell, the net collapses and the projectile continues in the direction it was going before it was caught in the net

name: Dimensional Tear
effect:
Send a beam of pure unraveling magic at a creature or object in range.
It deals 5d12 unraveling damage with a basic Reflex Saving throw.
Shields, armors and objects hit by Disintegrate are destroyed unless they are enchanted with anti-magic runes or made of Adamantium or Mithril

name: Earthquake
effect:
Shake the earth and land.
Any creature on land in a 200 tile burst around the in range need to fortitude save or be knocked prone and take 3d6 physical damage.
This spell deals heavy damage to buildings and terrain.
You may repeat the effect of the spell as you sustain it.

name: Inferno
effect:
Creates a 10x10 roaring fire of primordial proportions at a location you can see within range.
It deals 10d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save.
The fire spreads to any flammable materials nearby and cannot be put out by nonmagical means while you sustain it.
Water or Ice spells may attempt to make a contested check to put out part of the fire.

name: Miniature Sun
effect:
Conure a miniature sun in the palm of your hand.
The sun starts as a tiny object that hovers in the air in front of you. 
It emits bright light for 8 tiles and dim light for 8 tiles more. 
Any creature that moves into the bright light or ends its turn there need to make a Fortitude save or take 3d8 fire damage.
You are immune to all negative effects of the sun.
Creatures that target you with an attack need to make a Fortitude save or be Blinded for the turn

name: Pyroblast
effect:
Sends forth a stream of superheated flame in a line.
The line is up to 10 tiles long and 1 tile wide.
Any creatures in the area need to make a Reflex saving throw or take 15d6 fire damage.
Due to supernatural heat of the spell, fire resistance is half as effective against it

name: Simulacra
duration: As long as you maintain them
effect:
Create a copy of yourself out of magic. 
The copy appears exactly as you. When you make the simulacra you may choose to give it illusory clothes that appears as normal clothes, but cannot be interacted with
The copy has 5d6 health and aura. 
It can take any actions you can do except those with the "Soul" trait. 
When it casts spells, reinforces it's aura or uses mana in any way it uses your mana.
The simulacra cannot be healed or benefit from potions or the like, but can spend an action to drain 1d8 of your mana to restore that much health to it.
You always know the location of your Simulacras
After you take a long rest you must spend mana equal to half the cost of this spell per Simulacra you maintain. 
Simulacras can dismiss themselves as free action

name: Storm of Swords
effect:
A devastating spell that allows the caster to control an array of metallic objects, often swords, spears and other weapons, simultaneously, striking with unparalleled precision. 
When you cast or sustain the spell you may throw up to 3 metal objects at creatures within range, dealing 3d8 physical damage with a basic Reflex save for each
Additionally you may keep a number of metal objects hovering around equal to your level + your INT + your WIL.
If you have at least 5 objects hovering around you, any creature that starts it turn within 3 tiles or moves into the area must make a Reflex saving throw or take 2d8 physical damage.

name: Sunbeam
effect:
Create a massive illuminating beam of burning light 
The beam is a 5 tile wide and 30 tile long.
Any creatures in the line must make a Fortitude save. 
Success: Target is dazzled for one turn and takes 4d6 fire damage
Failure: Target is blinded for one turn and dazzled for one minute and takes 8d6 fire damage
Critical Failure: Target is blinded for one minute and takes double damage
While affected by this spell, the target can spend one action to attempt to redo the save, removing the remaining effects on a success.

name: Tornado
effect:
Conjure a massive swirling whirlwind that move around and pick up objects.
The tornado is 3x3 area, 20 tiles tall. 
Creatures that start their turn or enter the area of the tornade need to make a Reflex or Fortitude saving throw, taking 6d8 bludgeoning damage and being sucked up into the tornado and moved 4 tiles up on a failure.
Creatures stuck in the tornado are move with it and are off-guard 4. They can spend an action on their turn to attempt to escape, making a Athletics check against the spell. Creatures stuck in the tornado take 6d8 bludgeoning damage and are lifted 3 tiles up in the tornado at the start of their turns.
When you sustain the spell you may move the tornado up to 6 tiles.

name: True Lightning
effect:
Create an extremely fast bolt of true lightning to strike a target in range
The target needs to make a basic Reflex save, taking 8d12 lightning damage on failure.
If the target is wearing armor made of metal or holding a metal object it makes this save with a -16 modifier, otherwise the modifier is -8.

name: Tsunami
effect:
Creates a massive wave of water that crashes down on everything in its path. 
The waves take the form of 10 tile wide line or 15 tile wide if your in water.
The line moves 5 tiles forward when you cast the spell and at the end of your turn while the spell lasts Creatures hit by the save make a Fortitude saving throw.
 Success: The creature takes half damage and is moved 1 tile back
 Failure: The creature takes 6d10 bludgeoning damage and is moved 3 tiles back
 Critical Failure: The creature takes double damage and is moved 6 tiles back
